purpose: Measure the six positive cases missing after local ENOSPC, on a clean dedicated VM checkout. Preserve the original controls, all findings and both infrastructure incidents; this does not replace an unfavorable completed quality measurement.
execution: Remote VM only, one runner and one shared queue; no local model or full-suite process.
sandbox: local on the VM, reproduction disabled as in the original baseline
sampling: Freeze each completed raw case and the 20 smallest SHA-256(seed + NUL + finding key) off-list findings, or all if fewer, in Git before reading the selected descriptions. No replacements based on outcome.
judgment: Exact-claim, pinned-source inspection by Codex, with raw-result and source hashes, date and reason. Not an independent human review.
scoring: Report development and confirmation separately. Keep the 60% per-language precision floor and unknown findings unchanged. Record recall as baseline only.
priorControls: The three f7723e64b control snapshots remain separate historical measurements, including three false reports, the real UUID uniqueness defect and incomplete coverage. Do not relabel them or imply they measured this exact commit.
releaseLimitations: Positive-case precision alone cannot certify the clean-control requirement. The assumed-clean UUID control is contaminated; complete valid control evidence is still required. No overall release pass until all conditions are measured and met.
